title: The raw cyclic five-term Hom calculation
statement: With the data of [def-sf-cyclic-derived-hom-data] and the uniquely specified unbounded native boundary c(u) of [lem-sf-cyclic-derived-off-diagonal-presentation], c is additive, and the sequence V^{-1}(M,N) --(1-T)--> V^{-1}(M,N) --c--> Hom_B(M,N) --forget--> V^0(M,N) --(1-T)--> V^0(M,N) is exact at its three interior terms. Furthermore a c(u) d = c(U(a) u U(d)[-1]) for all native morphisms a:M′→M and d:N→N′. No boundedness is imposed. This does not yet descend to a quotient, identify an invariant subgroup, or prove uniqueness of a bounded boundary family.

proof.text: Obtain a normalized free triangle in the specified independent localizations and its additive Hom coordinates. Identify its concrete boundary with the strict off-diagonal boundary by the normalized SES comparison. Additivity follows from the additive Hom equivalence and composition with delta.

Apply yoneda_exact3 to the rotated triangle, yoneda_exact3 to the original triangle and yoneda_exact2 to the original triangle. Transport by the additive Hom equivalences, using their counit formula. The differential-coordinate calculation says p(Tu)=-(1-T)u. Since T is bijective, this gives equality of ranges of p and 1-T; injectivity of T also gives equality of their kernels. Thus obtain all three exact pairs. Keep the rotation minus sign by negating the factorizing map.

Naturality follows by moving precomposition across the natural delta and then applying naturality of the shifted Hom equivalence. The separate forgetting-zero theorem continues to use the existing strict-presentation forgetting calculation.

theorem cyclicDerivedOffDiagonal_calculus [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{v} C] :
    (∀ (M N : DerivedCategory (IsoAlgebra F)) (u v : CyclicDerivedHom F M N (-1)),
      cyclicDerivedOffDiagonalBoundary F (u + v) =
        cyclicDerivedOffDiagonalBoundary F u + cyclicDerivedOffDiagonalBoundary F v) ∧
    (∀ M N : DerivedCategory (IsoAlgebra F),
      Function.Exact (cyclicDerivedHomDefect F M N (-1))
        (cyclicDerivedOffDiagonalBoundary F (M := M) (N := N)) ∧
      Function.Exact (cyclicDerivedOffDiagonalBoundary F (M := M) (N := N))
        (cyclicDerivedForget F M N) ∧
      Function.Exact (cyclicDerivedForget F M N) (cyclicDerivedHomDefect F M N 0)) ∧
    (∀ (M N M' N' : DerivedCategory (IsoAlgebra F)) (a : M' ⟶ M) (c : N ⟶ N')
      (u : CyclicDerivedHom F M N (-1)),
      a ≫ cyclicDerivedOffDiagonalBoundary F u ≫ c =
        cyclicDerivedOffDiagonalBoundary F
          ((forget F).mapDerivedCategory.map a ≫ u ≫
            ((forget F).mapDerivedCategory.map c)⟦(-1 : ℤ)⟧'))
